flags.observation: "Uncle FrizzleBob here, your narrator" plus card count and "one breath each" is production meta that could front any deck track.
Style B specifies a dry female lead, while this beat names Uncle FrizzleBob as the narrator; voice and frame clash.
"For insiders:" announces the dog whistles, then lists three references in 113 characters; no setup or punch, hard in one breath.
"exacerbated the panic" fuses two card clauses; on the card the exacerbated object is the greatest economic disaster, not the panic.
"for Wall Street banks it exerts final dominance" has inverted, clumsy word order that stalls the spoken line.
The card's core claim, the bundled predatory loan, is dropped; only the casino aftermath remains.
"Rescued, the hippo." inverted fragment trips the spoken flow and reads as clipped stage direction.
"financial control of each political system" shifts the card's meaning of dominating each country's political system.
The concrete G7-to-G20 expansion from the card is dropped; the line ends on an abstraction.
Beats 21 to 29 run nine cards without any opener; the pivot from cartel cards to resistance cards gets no bridge.
All card callbacks in openers (beats 6, 18, 20, 30) point only to the immediately preceding card; no longer-range callback.
"if you trust money to stay power, you trust it to your enemy" is garbled syntax, not graspable in one hearing.
"So, scissors out." is the third So-opener, only four lines after "So trust no printer."; same family too close.
